Ab wie viel Dezibel über dem gemessenen: How many decibels above the measured noise floor count as sound.
Audio-Service nicht erreichbar — läuft d: Audio service unreachable — is it running on the Mac?
Aus bedeutet: Es wird genau dort geschni: Off means the cut lands exactly where you pressed. The “Fix edges” button in the segment area still works by hand.
Automatik läuft — wartet auf den nächste: Automatic mode is running — waiting for the next item
Beispielsatz zum Ausprobieren: Example sentence to try it on
Blende am Anfang und Ende jedes Segments: Fade at the start and end of each segment.
Die Auswahl im Kopf jeder Seite. Bis zu: The picker in the header of every page. Up to four of them appear as large tiles on the start page. Hiding one takes it out of the picker without touching the archive.
The track buttons during a recording.
Für diesen Gottesdienst ist keine Checkl: No checklist is set up for this service.
Gemessen, nicht geschätzt: bei 5 s zersc: Measured, not guessed: at 5 s pauses in speech cut the sermon apart, at 15 s consecutive items melt together.
Geschützt: an diesem Namen hängt Logik: Protected: logic depends on this name
Geschützt: der Name steht in den Ansage-: Protected: the name appears in the announcement rules or serves as an anchor
Gilt für alle Gottesdienstarten ohne eig: Applies to every service type without its own template. Square brackets make a part optional.
Applies to the service type “Hochzeit” (wedding). Without a couple and without a part number the bracketed groups disappear.
Höher heißt größere Dateien, nicht hörba: Higher means larger files, not audibly better speech. 192k is the value that grew out of practice.
Icecast- oder RTMP-Adresse. Enthält Zuga: Icecast or RTMP address. Contains credentials — masked in displays and logs. Empty means: use the target from the .env.
Kein Eingangssignal — Audio-Dienst oder: No input signal — check the audio service or Dante
Keine Marker in dieser Session — keine S: No markers in this session — nothing to export.
Kürzeres gilt nicht als eigener Programm: Anything shorter does not count as its own programme item. Also decides how early the first marker appears.
Marker prüfen, Typen korrigieren, einzel: Check markers, correct types, export single segments afterwards. Automatic mode does not touch these recordings.
Neue Beitragsart, z.B. Posaunenchor: New item type, e.g. Brass band
Neue Gottesdienstart, z.B. Jugendstunde: New service type, e.g. Youth meeting
Punkte anlegen, umbenennen und sortieren: Add, rename and sort items. You tick them off before the service under
Add, rename and sort items. You tick the checklist itself off before the service under
RTMP-URL für den Livestream (z.B. YouTub: RTMP URL for the livestream (e.g. YouTube, your own server)
So lange muss Ton anliegen, damit er als: Sound must hold this long to count as a real start.
This much quiet must precede the start. Pauses between sentences are around 500 ms and must not count, or the edge jumps around in continuous speech.
Stream-Ziel in den Einstellungen setzen: Set the stream target in the settings
Verschiebt den Schnitt auf die leiseste: Moves the cut to the quietest point nearby. Edges set by hand are left alone.
Wertet die Ansagen im Transkript aus, um: Reads the announcements in the transcript to guess the type of the next item. Titles always stay display-only.
Wie viele der fünf Klangmerkmale für Spr: How many of the five acoustic features must vote for speech.
Wie weit um den gesetzten Zeitpunkt nach: How far around the marked moment the quietest point is looked for.
Wird nach dem letzten Ton zusätzlich beh: Kept in addition after the last sound.
Wird vor dem ersten Ton zusätzlich behal: Kept in addition before the first sound.
Takes effect only after a service restart.
Woran die Automatik in einer Ansage erke: How automatic mode tells from an announcement which item is coming. The first matching rule wins. Every congregation announces differently — “our choir will sing” does not fit everywhere. Try a pattern before saving it.
What each segment is normalised to. −3 dBFS leaves room for further processing.
Während einer Aufnahme nicht änderbar: Cannot be changed during a recording
Zieht Anfang und Ende jedes Tracks auf d: Pulls the start and end of each track onto the actual audio when the button came too early or too late. Runs when the recording stops. Where there is no real pause — during continuous speech, say — your mark stays put.
bedeutet: hier gilt alles davor als erle: means everything before this counts as done.
sagt der Erkennung, ob der Typ zu gemess: tells the detection whether the type fits measured music or speech — empty means it is never suggested on its own, only when announced or set by hand.
· Aufnahmedatei fehlt, kein Export mögli: · recording file missing, no export possible
Über Lautsprecher koppelt der Ton in die: Through speakers the sound feeds back into the microphones and ends up in the recording.
